description:
We are looking for an IT Support Specialist / Network and Systems Technician with German language skills for a long-term, hybrid role at our German client's office.

In this role, you will support the implementation and maintenance of IT systems and network solutions within a proprietary IT infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

  • Proprietary IT systems integration.
  • Implementation of proprietary communication and network solutions.
  • Execution of system integration projects in a specific contained environment.
  • Support in planning and executing migration and upgrading projects.
  • Administration of network components (routers, firewalls, switches, and wireless).
  • Configuration documentation.
  • Troubleshooting, issues determination, analysis, tracking.

Needed knowledge and experience:

  • Several years of professional experience in IT field, training and specializations.
  • Proven experience in operating complex network structures.
  • Experience in configuring network components (routers, switches, Cisco, Aruba, Alcatel, etc. or similar).
  • Knowledge of key network technologies, such as: VLAN, Routing, IPv4, IPv6, Spanning Tree.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux.
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory, DFS, DHCP, DNS, group policies, and certificate services.

Desirable knowledge in one of the following areas:

  • Firewall systems and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell).
  • Radio technologies, e.g., LTE, voice E2EE, and digital radio, etc.

AQUASoft is an equal opportunity employer. We invest in people, and we make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, skills, and business needs.
